##### Project general facts

HQ by Arista Properties is a boutique commercial building designed for ambitious businesses, combining contemporary architecture with clean geometry and expressive facade lines. The building rises above three basement levels and a ground floor to seven office floors and a roof. The project offers Grade A office units together with a small selection of ground-floor retail spaces, with flexible layouts, spacious floor plates and a polished, hospitality-inspired environment from the double-height arrival lobby upwards.

Curated amenities make the working day more productive and enjoyable, including a co-working lounge, meeting pods, a conference room and podcast studios. A gym, an outdoor yoga deck, a rooftop garden, a swimming pool, wellness terraces and a workout zone support wellbeing, while an in-house cafe, a game zone, a dedicated service lobby, smart access control, intelligent security systems and high-speed connectivity in common areas create a seamless business environment.

Interiors are designed around flexibility and Grade A commercial standards, with shell-and-core units that allow each business to customise its space, full-height glazing that brings natural light into every office and architectural lighting throughout. Wet pantries and shared utilities on every floor, water and drainage provisions in every unit and a sustainability-led approach to materials and building systems support efficient long-term operation for occupiers and owners.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a well-established community in the Jebel Ali area, known for its landscaped parks, walkable streets and a balanced mix of villas, townhouses and apartment buildings. Furjan West Park and the Furjan West Community Centre sit nearby, while cafes, restaurants, supermarkets and services along the community boulevards create a convenient setting for businesses and their teams.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect the building with the wider city. The Al Furjan metro station and the Etihad Rail station are a short drive away, Dubai Investment Park and Jebel Ali Free Zone are close by, and Dubai Marina, Dubai Media City, Dubai Internet City and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach for staff and clients.

Al Furjan is a freehold community open to international buyers and part of the fast-growing Jebel Ali and Dubai South corridor. Proximity to major free zones, logistics hubs and the metro attracts companies seeking modern, efficient offices outside the congested central districts. Limited supply of Grade A boutique offices in the area supports steady leasing demand and long-term value for investors.
